resources.string: The database chosen before is no longer in the list: quick notes go to the current one.

Text shared to Keething note or picked from a text\'s menu, the tile and the launcher\'s Note from clipboard open a new note in that database\'s Inbox, made with the note when there is none. Nothing is saved until you save it.
The stored passwords could not be deleted: %1$s.

Each database whose Use fingerprint is on opens with it: its lock screen offers it once, by the fingerprint beside the password, and its page in Databases turns it on or off. Turning this off deletes all their stored passwords.
Ask about each master key every
After this long without its master password typed, Keething asks once, after an unlock, whether you still remember it (or keep its key file safe). The fingerprint opens it all the same.
Keething never asks. A forgotten master password, or a lost key file, opens its database for nobody, not even with Keething.
On: apps and browsers offer the matching entries. In Chrome, also choose Settings › Autofill services › Autofill using another service; Firefox needs nothing.
Off: another service fills, or none.
Lock after this long in the background
Turning the screen off counts as the background. The clipboard is cleared 30 s after a copy.
Then the phone that asked forgets its key, and an answer can no longer be opened; the phone that sent entries without a request forgets their pictures. New ones only.
The last unlock derived the key in %1$s.
The last read of the file reused the derived key.
Passwords and codes are set in Google Sans Code (SIL Open Font License 1.1).
